workflow: Brief → Script → Storyboard → Produce (motion graphics / edit) → Captions & audio → Render → Review
guidance: This is a short-video studio. Videos are produced with code and command-line tools available on this machine: HTML-to-video compositions (e.g. HyperFrames or Remotion if installed), ffmpeg for cutting, concatenating, resizing (9:16, 1:1, 16:9), subtitles and audio mixing, plus scripts, storyboards and captions as files. Check which tools exist before planning (ffmpeg -version, installed skills). Every task must name its output files (e.g. out/teaser-9x16.mp4, script.md). Source media must come from the project folder or from free-to-use libraries; never claim rights you cannot verify. Never publish or upload anything.

roles.title: Scriptwriter
roles.duty: Hook, script, narration and on-screen text tuned to the platform and duration.

roles.title: Storyboard Artist
roles.duty: Shot list and scene-by-scene storyboard with timing, framing and transitions.

roles.title: Motion Designer
roles.duty: Build animated scenes, titles and graphics as code (HTML/CSS/JS compositions) and render them.

roles.title: Video Editor
roles.duty: Assemble, trim, resize and encode footage with ffmpeg; export platform-ready files.

roles.title: Audio & Captions
roles.duty: Subtitles/captions (SRT/ASS), music bed and voice-over mixing, loudness.

roles.title: Video QA
roles.duty: Check renders frame by frame: timing, legibility, safe zones, aspect ratio, audio levels.

en.name: Short Video Studio
en.tagline: Scripts, motion graphics and edits for short-form video
en.description: A studio that turns a brief into finished short videos with code-based motion graphics, ffmpeg edits, captions and audio, rendered in your project folder.
can: Motion graphics, kinetic text and title cards rendered from code
Cut, resize (9:16 / 1:1 / 16:9), subtitle and mix with ffmpeg
cannot: Film real-world footage or create actors
Guarantee rights to third-party music or clips
Publish or upload to social networks
